pk.context: 801 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

clues.kinetics: The absolute bioavailability has not been determined, and food lowers peak concentration by about 49%. About 58% is bound to plasma proteins, and about 80% of the dose is excreted in urine as a metabolite.
clues.substance: Molecular weight 185.22. A white to pale yellow, non-hygroscopic powder.
clues.product: Approved under an NDA in 267 mg capsules and in 267 mg and 801 mg tablets; the 801 mg dose is three capsules.
clues.safety: No boxed warning and no contraindications. Rash and nausea are the adverse reactions most often leading to discontinuation.
clues.mechanism: Its mechanism of action in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis has not been established.
